entities.summary: Leighton Lucas was an English composer and conductor. His career was wide-ranging: he was associated with the revival of interest in 20th century English ballet, arranged music for dance bands, conducted challenging contemporary classical works and wrote many original concert and film scores. Leighton Lucas was a heads of state & government (1903-01-05–1982-11-01). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
